about_the_game:
"Balaball" is a rouge-like game based on physical collision and deck building. Experience the pleasure of constantly getting high scores in chaotic collisions. Find the strongest scoring combination in different situations, trigger crazy chains and high scores, constantly break through the original balance, and get new high scores step by step.

Collision brings both chaos and luck.

Game Features

Shoot the pinball to collide with various items in the scene and earn scores. Choose and deploy new items in each round, and constantly improve the diversity of the scene. Earn higher scores in chaos!

In each round, there is a chance to obtain BUFFs and upgrade items that would gradually break the original balance and find a new way to win.

Dominate a variety of situations. The game provides many levels and a variety of situations. Maybe you have found the winning strategy in the "fast food truck" level, but how will you deal with it in the "dungeon"? Many unique situations require you to find new combinations to build, try more strategies and ideas, and break the original records.

A variety of items and BUFFs. Ore generates jewels, eggs generate chicks, chicks may turn into fire dragons, and there are black holes that can swallow everything... Try a variety of different combinations to explore more possibilities!

"Balaball" provides you with endless playability and brings you unlimited fun!
